text:
maria: Heads up — starting Lytica LoRA merge bring-up using the int8 runtime. Attaching a quick eval pack, running baseline + smoke.

raj: nice. did you run tokenizer alignment first? we saw token-id drift on their dataset last time.

maria: yes, ran align_tokenmap.py against their tokenizer bundle. command i used:
```
python infra/token_align.py --src models/base-lytica/tokenizer.json --dst customers/lytica/tokenizer.json --out tmp/token_map.json
```

ci-bot: smoke tests queued: run/1723421000-lyt-smoke (priority: high) :rocket:

oliver: quick note — after first 20 prompts embeddings look stable, but invoice-amount parsing drops ~2% accuracy compared to our fp16 baseline.

sara: customer flagged amount hallucinations as blocker in staging. they need deterministic amounts for invoices.

maria: saw 3/50 prompts produce incorrect totals (negative or swapped cents). Trying a quant-config tweak and smaller batch to reduce KV cache misalignment. Pushing config: 
```
quant: int8
group_size: 128
act-order: symmetric
kv_cache_prefill: false  # try disabling for canary
```

raj: SGTM. also try token_fix branch I pushed (token_fix/lyt-compat) — fixes a subtle offset in token ids for currency symbols.

ci-bot: smoke tests started -> run/1723421000-lyt-smoke: 0/50 complete.

maria: running full quick eval now with the script: 
```
python tools/run_quick_eval.py --model base-lytica --lora lytica-lora-v3 --quant int8 --prompts eval_packs/lytica_invoices.json --out /tmp/lyt_eval.json --batch-size 4
```

maria: results: 50 prompts total, 47 pass, 3 amount hallucinations (samples #12, #27, #44). Latency +12% vs fp16 for tail p95, overall cost estimate -45% token compute. Output snippet for failing case:
```
input: "Calculate total for items: $12.99, $3.50, $5.00"
fp16_expected: "$21.49"
int8_model_output: "-$21.49"  # sign flipped
```

oliver: hmm sign flip looks like token ordering/byte-interpretation bug, not pure quant noise. Might be the token_fix branch helps. If it doesn't, we'll route invoice endpoints to fp16 for canary.

sara: customer is ok with a canary if fallback to fp16 is enforced for invoice routes. Please include that in rollout notes.

maria: will do. Plan: 1) rerun with token_fix + kv_cache_prefill=false; 2) if fixes, create canary roll (10% traffic) with fallback to base-fp16 for invoice route; 3) attach eval JSON + failing prompts to ticket.

raj: also add a small unit test for currency token sequences so this doesn't regress.

maria: added to my todo and I'll open infra/rollout-1723421000 with attachments. pinging @sara for CS notes. :memo:

sara: thanks — I'll prep the customer message and include the canary plan. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: smoke tests complete: 50/50. summary: 47 OK, 3 regressions (amount parsing). Logs: /ci/artifacts/run/1723421000/summary.json :white_check_mark:

maria: closing this thread, will update the rollout ticket with artifacts and canary config.
